sequence: D3.5 — Structured Evidence-Link Reachability & Bridging — IN_PROGRESS
D4 — Incremental migration of appropriate query expansions — NOT_STARTED

problem_statement: The current structured path can resolve governed objects and traverse accepted D1 structure, but it does not yet provide a sufficiently generic, bounded, auditable bridge from resolved governed identity to retrieval-addressable source evidence. D3 exposed two distinct mechanism classes: A. governed evidence provenance already exists but is not reachable and/or not materialized into source-native retrieval candidates; B. the required governed evidence provenance does not yet exist.

frozen_facts: accepted workflow.restgas.first_pass_poca CONSUMES data_product.restgas.pid_root and PRODUCES data_product.restgas.boost_root relations carry macro/target/ana_dpm.C provenance in repository D1
the provenance-bearing structure is not reachable under the frozen one-hop A1 traversal
A1 does not materialize relation-level provenance into source-native candidates
required source evidence has no inspectable governed provenance in the current D1 structure
no path, predicate, or new linkage is selected in A0

governed_structural_reachability.definition: D2-resolved governed object -> existing governed structural context -> provenance-bearing governed object, accepted relation, or curated workflow step.
eligible_primitives: accepted relation traversal under predicate and type policy
reverse accepted relation traversal under predicate and type policy
curated workflow membership and workflow-step participation

evidence_provenance_materialization.definition: Reached governed object, accepted relation, or curated workflow -> validated governed evidence provenance -> retrieval-addressable source-native evidence candidate.

genuine_evidence_link_coverage.definition: When required source evidence genuinely lacks governed provenance, add only narrowly justified, source-grounded, version-grounded, reviewable, reusable governed evidence linkage.
genuine_evidence_link_coverage.counterfactual_gate: The linkage must remain semantically justified if the motivating evaluation case did not exist.
genuine_evidence_link_coverage.preference: Add evidence provenance to an already correct governed object, relation, or workflow before considering a new ontology relation or object.

Tier_G.constraints: Traversal starts from the governed matched seed; canonical identity remains bounded to accepted Tier-G co-reference evidence.

Tier_S.constraints: Matched-record structure only; canonical_object_id remains null and no cross-record canonicalization is permitted.

Tier_D_unique.constraints: May add a bounded structured branch but may not filter, restrict scope, route exclusively, canonicalize, or override other seeds.

Tier_D_ambiguous.constraints: Treat the complete governed ambiguity set atomically. If its size is at most 8 and the whole set fits the global seed budget remaining after stronger independent Tier-G, Tier-S, and Tier-D-unique seeds are processed in existing authority order, preserve and traverse every alternative. If the set exceeds 8 or does not fit the remaining budget, preserve the full receipt, traverse none from that branch, and emit STRUCTURAL_PATH_AMBIGUOUS with reason AMBIGUITY_SET_EXCEEDS_SAFE_SEED_BUDGET. Never truncate, sample, or take a top-8 subset.

corrective_only.constraints: No identity traversal. A corrective term may accompany traversal only when an independent valid Tier-G, Tier-S, or Tier-D governed seed exists.

UNRESOLVED.constraints: No seed and no negative filtering.

SAME_AS.constraints: Excluded from reachability and does not increase resolver authority.

parent_object_id.required_governance: Persisted governed parent reference passing D1 parent integrity validation
parent_object_id.version_scope_constraints: Child and parent must resolve in the accepted structured state and pass RetrievalPlan source/version scope
parent_object_id.object_type_constraints: The child must be a contained object and the parent a valid container or containing artifact under the governed parent contract
parent_object_id.boundary: At most one upward containment transition per root seed. Parent-to-child fan-out is not eligible in A1.
parent_object_id.identity_statement: Structural containment is not identity; a child is never canonicalized to its parent.

accepted_relation_subject_to_object.required_governance: review_status accepted; predicate explicitly eligible; SAME_AS excluded
accepted_relation_subject_to_object.version_scope_constraints: Both endpoints and any materialized evidence must pass plan scope

accepted_relation_object_to_subject.required_governance: Original accepted edge and predicate provenance preserved; reverse eligibility is explicit, not inferred from generic adjacency
accepted_relation_object_to_subject.version_scope_constraints: Both endpoints and any materialized evidence must pass plan scope

workflow_step_entrypoint.required_governance: Curated seed workflow step with valid entrypoint and D1 workflow integrity
workflow_step_entrypoint.version_scope_constraints: Participants and evidence pass plan scope

workflow_step_inputs_outputs.directionality: INPUT_TO_STEP, STEP_TO_OUTPUT, OUTPUT_TO_PRODUCING_STEP, AND STEP_TO_INPUT_AS EXPLICIT PARTICIPATION DIRECTIONS
workflow_step_inputs_outputs.required_governance: Curated seed workflow step passing D1 workflow integrity
workflow_step_inputs_outputs.version_scope_constraints: Participants and evidence pass plan scope

workflow_containment_membership.required_governance: Membership must be explicitly represented by a curated workflow record; no inferred membership
workflow_containment_membership.version_scope_constraints: Participants and evidence pass plan scope

source_native_evidence_provenance.required_governance: Accepted provenance origin plus successful strict source-native resolution

DATAFLOW.constraints: Endpoint types must conform to the governed predicate meaning; reverse traversal answers producer/consumer reachability but never reverses the stored predicate.

IMPLEMENTATION_AND_FORMALIZATION.constraints: Only accepted governed endpoints; relation direction remains explicit and supplies no co-reference authority.

WORKFLOW_AND_PARAMETERIZATION.constraints: Reverse traversal is allowed only to the accepted governed source of the stored relationship and within compatible endpoint types.

DOCUMENTATION.constraints: Document-to-governed-object linkage only; no repository-wide document expansion.

REPOSITORY_PROVENANCE.constraints: Both repository versions must already be explicitly in RetrievalPlan/context scope; this relation cannot widen repository scope.

rejected_options.raw_graph_edge_count: Rejected because it treats containment, workflow participation, and semantic relations as interchangeable adjacency.
rejected_options.increase_global_max_relation_hops_to_2: Rejected because it is case-shaped, widens ordinary graph behavior, and does not bound parent/workflow composition.
rejected_options.untyped_bfs: Rejected because it permits graph explosion and erases predicate semantics.

phases.budget: up to 8 eligible governed seeds, deterministically ordered
zero or one child-to-parent transition per root seed
zero or one accepted predicate transition OR one curated workflow-step/membership transition per root-to-provenance path
terminal only; does not create a new graph frontier

traversal_budget_policy.deduplication: Deterministic by root seed, governed node ID, edge or workflow-step ID, transition type, and source-native candidate object_id.
traversal_budget_policy.budget_exhaustion_behavior: Stop the affected branch, emit TRAVERSAL_BUDGET_EXHAUSTED, preserve ordinary retrieval, and never widen the budget at runtime.

query_relevance_boundary.allowed_use: Deterministically order or select among already-governed, already-reachable structures and already-resolved candidates when a cap binds, using ordinary query and RetrievalPlan signals.
prohibited_uses: use an LLM assertion as graph truth

evidence_object_ids.contract: Each ID must resolve exactly to an existing indexed source-native knowledge object that passes source/version scope. Curated domain objects may remain provenance anchors but are not source-native candidates unless they themselves satisfy the source-native contract.

evidence_paths.contract: A path is only a governed lookup key. It must resolve through the strict path-to-source-object contract before candidate creation; raw path strings are never injected.

source_locators.contract: A structured locator may resolve a candidate only with explicit source and version scope and one exact source-native match.

path_to_source_object_resolution.lookup_key: source_id + source_version_id + canonical repository-relative locator path
path_to_source_object_resolution.path_normalization: Convert separators to '/', remove a single leading './', reject absolute paths and parent-directory traversal, and preserve case; no basename-only or substring matching.
path_to_source_object_resolution.matching_semantics: Exact equality against the indexed canonical/source-native path within the qualified source/version scope.
path_to_source_object_resolution.source_scope: Use evidence_source_ids intersected with RetrievalPlan target/context sources; a single evidence source may qualify all listed paths. Multiple eligible sources are searched independently but the final match must be unique.
path_to_source_object_resolution.version_scope: Use explicit source_version_ids when present only if they agree with RetrievalPlan; otherwise use the RetrievalPlan locked version for the evidence source. Never select latest or widen the plan.
path_to_source_object_resolution.object_type_handling: Preserve the resolved indexed object_type. For a path-only locator, select the unique path-owning source-native container object, not arbitrary chunks or symbol descendants. A more specific governed locator or evidence_object_id may select a specific indexed descendant.
path_to_source_object_resolution.multiple_match_behavior: Fail closed with PROVENANCE_SOURCE_OBJECT_AMBIGUOUS; inject none and retain all match identities in the receipt.
path_to_source_object_resolution.zero_match_behavior: Fail closed with PROVENANCE_SOURCE_OBJECT_NOT_FOUND; inject no raw path string.

source_version_scope_contract.scope_conflict_behavior: Do not inject, do not alter the RetrievalPlan, emit VERSION_SCOPE_CONFLICT, and preserve ordinary retrieval results.
source_version_scope_contract.cross_repository_behavior: A relation cannot introduce a repository absent from target_repositories or context_sources. Repository provenance predicates do not widen scope.
source_version_scope_contract.missing_version_behavior: Do not infer latest. Path-only provenance without a plan-consistent version cannot materialize.

candidate_authority_contract.provenance_identity_statement: The provenance-bearing governed object/relation/workflow and the source evidence candidate remain distinct identities.

candidate_integration_contract.merge_behavior: Deduplicate source-native candidates by object_id, then prefix the bounded structured_evidence substream into the existing graph stream under existing stable merge semantics and the existing graph channel limit. This explicit within-graph prefix precedence may displace ordinary graph candidates when the graph limit binds.
candidate_integration_contract.rrf_vote_behavior: No separate RRF vote and no double counting; bridged candidates receive the existing graph channel weight only.

failure_taxonomy.scope: D3.5 engineering and focused-validation diagnostics; does not replace the frozen D3 formal taxonomy

runtime_materialization_prerequisite.decision: D3.5-A1 must begin with a read-only comparison between the starting repository-governed D1 identity and a separate isolated D3.5 evaluation materialization identity. If the isolated state is stale, controlled ingestion may target that isolated state only. If approved Mechanism-C changes occur during A1, the isolated state must be resynchronized to match D3_5_A2_FINAL_REPOSITORY_D1_IDENTITY before pre-A2 freezes. The deployed production materialization is a distinct identity and must remain untouched.
runtime_materialization_prerequisite.known_state_implication: The historical D3 deployed 22/16/0 materialization is non-interchangeable with the synchronized isolated D3.5 evaluation arm and is not an ingestion target.
reingestion_contract: record the isolated target identity and exact counts
materialize only independently approved current D1 state
do not consume D3 evaluation outcomes or legacy payloads as knowledge
do not treat synchronization as a scientific treatment
do not write to or rewrite the deployed production materialization
runtime_materialization_prerequisite.isolation_failure_behavior: Stop before ingestion and report D3.5-A1 BLOCKED / ISOLATED_MATERIALIZATION_UNAVAILABLE; never silently rewrite the deployed database.

anti_shortcut_constraints.principle: D3.5 must replace answer-location shortcuts with governed structural/evidence semantics, not merely move the shortcut from YAML into the graph.
prohibited_shapes: object-ID special branch equivalent to if event_poca return ana_dpm.C

d3_5_a1_contract.name: D3.5-A1 — Bounded Structured Evidence-Link Bridging Prototype
prerequisite_sequence: establish an isolated D3.5 evaluation structured-state target
initially synchronize that isolated target to starting approved repository D1 (D3_5_A1_STARTING_REPOSITORY_D1_IDENTITY, currently 24/16/1)
implement and validate the bridge with synthetic, unit, or static fixtures
if approved Mechanism-C changes occur, update repository D1 configs and resynchronize isolated target to match D3_5_A2_FINAL_REPOSITORY_D1_IDENTITY
freeze A1 implementation, final repository D1 identity, and isolated evaluation materialization before A2
may: choose the smallest existing isolation mechanism and synchronize only the isolated D3.5 dev/evaluation materialization to independently approved current D1 state as an explicit prerequisite
implement generic typed governed structural reachability

add a narrowly justified Mechanism-C evidence linkage only after independent source inspection, version grounding, governance review, and the counterfactual gate; no linkage is preregistered by g021 outcome alone
emit separate reachability and bridge receipts
may_not: run formal focused g036/g021 recovery evaluation
run g036, g021, n006, g041, g020, or n004 through the formal retrieval comparison
change global fusion, reranker, or selector policy

run_manifest_must_record: whether D1 changed and change summary
stable object IDs, relation IDs/tuples, and workflow IDs
deterministic proof/accounting of materialization match to final repository D1

d3_5_a2_contract.name: D3.5-A2 — Focused Evidence-Link Recovery Validation

arms.LEGACY: The two selected legacy rules active; structured path and D3.5 bridge disabled.
arms.ABLATION: The two selected legacy rules suppressed; structured path and D3.5 bridge disabled.
arms.STRUCTURED_UNBRIDGED: The two selected legacy rules suppressed; synchronized current structured path enabled against final repository D1; D3.5 bridge disabled.
arms.STRUCTURED_BRIDGED: The two selected legacy rules suppressed; the same synchronized current structured path plus the frozen D3.5-A1 bridge enabled against final repository D1.

comparison_design.shared_materialization: All four arms use the same frozen synchronized isolated D3.5 evaluation materialization exactly matching D3_5_A2_FINAL_REPOSITORY_D1_IDENTITY.
comparison_design.historical_non_interchangeability: The historical D3 STRUCTURED arm used deployed 22/16/0 and is not interchangeable with the current synchronized STRUCTURED_UNBRIDGED arm.
comparison_design.identifiability_boundary: STRUCTURED_BRIDGED - ABLATION is the combined current structured-plus-bridge contribution and must not be described as a pure bridge effect.

scientific_interpretation.unbridged_vs_ablation: If STRUCTURED_UNBRIDGED > ABLATION, the final repository-governed D1 state and pre-D3.5 structured traversal path contribute to evidence recovery.
scientific_interpretation.bridged_vs_unbridged: If STRUCTURED_BRIDGED > STRUCTURED_UNBRIDGED, the D3.5 reachability/evidence bridge adds incremental recovery beyond the final governed D1 state.
scientific_interpretation.identifiability_boundary: STRUCTURED_BRIDGED - ABLATION is the combined current structured-plus-bridge contribution and must not be described as a pure bridge effect.

mechanism_interpretation_examples: LEGACY succeeds; ABLATION fails; STRUCTURED_UNBRIDGED fails; STRUCTURED_BRIDGED succeeds -> dependency confirmed, pre-D3.5 structured path does not recover under synchronized D1, and the D3.5 bridge incrementally recovers behavior.

LEGACY succeeds; ABLATION fails; STRUCTURED_UNBRIDGED succeeds; STRUCTURED_BRIDGED succeeds -> dependency confirmed, synchronized D1 plus the pre-D3.5 structured mechanism already recovers behavior, and an incremental bridge effect is not established.
LEGACY succeeds; ABLATION fails; STRUCTURED_UNBRIDGED partially succeeds; STRUCTURED_BRIDGED fully succeeds -> a pre-D3.5 contribution exists and the D3.5 bridge adds incremental recovery.
STRUCTURED_BRIDGED is worse than STRUCTURED_UNBRIDGED -> bridge-introduced regression.

controls.role: same subsystem with no governed evidence bridge required

d3_5_a2_contract.case_selection_policy: Use only already-exposed frozen D3 development cases selected by preregistered role, not treatment likelihood; make no additions or substitutions after A1 outcome exposure.

d3_5_success_criteria: generic reachability is bounded, deterministic, and auditable
bridged candidates derive only from accepted governed structure and validated provenance
no direct evaluation-shaped mapping or legacy-payload reuse
g036-type existing provenance can become a source-native candidate when it is structurally reachable
g021-type genuine coverage is independently source-grounded and reusable outside the motivating case
all four controls show no material overexpansion, abstention break, evidence displacement, or scope leakage
source/version/locator provenance remains valid and exact
bridged candidates remain additive and do not force selection
production defaults, fusion weights, reranker, selector, D1 authority, and query expansions remain unchanged
bridge incremental effect is identifiable separately from synchronized D1 and pre-D3.5 structured-path effects
Tier-D ambiguity is never partially truncated
deployed production structured state remains untouched during A1 and A2
graph-prefix displacement is measured and bounded

four_arm_contract.LEGACY: selected two legacy shortcuts enabled; existing D3 structured path disabled; D3.5 bridge disabled
four_arm_contract.ABLATION: selected two legacy shortcuts disabled; existing D3 structured path disabled; D3.5 bridge disabled
four_arm_contract.STRUCTURED_UNBRIDGED: selected two legacy shortcuts disabled; existing frozen D3-A1 structured path enabled; D3.5 reachability/evidence bridge disabled
four_arm_contract.STRUCTURED_BRIDGED: selected two legacy shortcuts disabled; existing structured path enabled; frozen D3.5-A1 bridge enabled

ambiguity_budget_repair.processing_order: Process independent Tier-G, Tier-S, and Tier-D-unique seeds first in existing authority order.
ambiguity_budget_repair.admit_whole_set_when: Complete Tier-D ambiguity set size is at most 8 and the whole set fits the remaining global seed budget.
ambiguity_budget_repair.fail_closed_when: Set size exceeds 8 or the whole set does not fit the remaining global seed budget.
ambiguity_budget_repair.fail_closed_action: Preserve the full ambiguity receipt, traverse none from that branch, and emit STRUCTURAL_PATH_AMBIGUOUS with reason AMBIGUITY_SET_EXCEEDS_SAFE_SEED_BUDGET.

runtime_isolation_contract.isolated_D3.5_evaluation_materialization: Separate dev/evaluation target synchronized to match D3_5_A2_FINAL_REPOSITORY_D1_IDENTITY using the smallest existing mechanism selected in A1.
runtime_isolation_contract.deployed_production_materialization_iden: Distinct deployed target; historical observation 22/16/0; untouched by D3.5 A1/A2 setup.
runtime_isolation_contract.mechanism_C_write_path: Repository config -> review/freeze -> isolated evaluation materialization only.
runtime_isolation_contract.starting_repository_governed_D1_identity: Authoritative approved repository seed state at A1 start: 24 objects / 16 accepted relations / 1 curated workflow step.
runtime_isolation_contract.final_repository_governed_D1_identity: Final approved repository seed state after A1 implementation/governance, authoritative for all A2 arms.

reasons: Restore causal identifiability with a synchronized four-arm design.
Make Tier-D ambiguity budget handling atomic and fail closed.
Separate repository, isolated evaluation, and deployed production materialization identities.
State within-graph prefix precedence and displacement diagnostics explicitly.

D3.5-A0-R2.issue: 24/16/1 was over-specified as the only possible A2 state rather than the authoritative starting repository D1 state at the beginning of A1. A1 may add a narrowly justified Mechanism-C governed evidence link, and provenance-only changes can alter identity without changing counts. A2 must freeze and use the final approved post-A1 repository-governed D1 identity and an isolated materialization proven to match it.
reasons: Distinguish D3_5_A1_STARTING_REPOSITORY_D1_IDENTITY (starting baseline, currently 24/16/1) from D3_5_A2_FINAL_REPOSITORY_D1_IDENTITY (final post-A1 authoritative identity).
Establish that object/relation/workflow counts are required accounting but insufficient for semantic identity.
Require three explicit pre-A2 freezes: D3_5_A1_IMPLEMENTATION_FROZEN, D3_5_A2_FINAL_REPOSITORY_D1_IDENTITY_FROZEN, and D3_5_EVALUATION_D1_MATERIALIZATION_FROZEN.
Specify exact matching between the isolated evaluation materialization and the final approved post-A1 repository D1 identity for all four A2 evaluation arms.
Define bounded, hash-inventory-free identity anchoring in normal repository state (Git SHA, config paths, stable IDs, SPO tuples, workflow IDs, provenance).
Define two-phase synchronization in A1 (initial sync to starting D1, resync to final D1 after approved Mechanism-C changes).

required_entry_condition: D3.5 structured evidence-link bridging mechanism validated by D3.5-A2
d4_dependency_contract.D4_role_unchanged: Incremental, reversible migration of appropriate query-expansion batches while retaining true terminology and normalization.

starting_repository_d1_identity.name: D3_5_A1_STARTING_REPOSITORY_D1_IDENTITY
starting_repository_d1_identity.definition: Approved repository-governed D1 state when D3.5-A1 implementation begins.

final_repository_d1_identity.name: D3_5_A2_FINAL_REPOSITORY_D1_IDENTITY
final_repository_d1_identity.definition: Final approved repository-governed D1 state after all D3.5-A1 implementation and any independently justified Mechanism-C governance changes, frozen before any D3.5-A2 outcome exposure.

d1_identity_freeze_contract.counts_insufficient_for_identity_stateme: Object count, accepted relation count, and curated workflow step count are required accounting metrics but are insufficient to define D1 semantic identity. Identical counts (e.g. 24/16/1) can differ in relation provenance, metadata, evidence paths/IDs, source/version grounding, relation identity, or workflow step content. Conversely, approved additions or deletions may change counts. Semantic identity requires anchoring in governed repository state.

identity_anchoring_specification.git_sha: Authoritative Git commit SHA containing the D1 state
identity_anchoring_specification.stable_governed_object_ids: Complete ordered list of governed object IDs
identity_anchoring_specification.stable_governed_relations: Complete ordered list of relation IDs or stable (subject, predicate, object) tuples
identity_anchoring_specification.stable_governed_workflow_steps: Complete ordered list of curated workflow step IDs
identity_anchoring_specification.relevant_provenance: Exact evidence provenance fields, source_ids, source_version_ids, and locator paths on all governed records

mechanism_c_governance_gate.counterfactual_gate: Would this linkage remain justified if the motivating evaluation case did not exist? Reject if no.
mechanism_c_governance_gate.preregistration_status: No linkage is preregistered by g021 outcome alone; must be evaluated and approved during A1 through normal D1 governance.

freeze_lifecycle: 1. Establish starting repository D1 identity (D3_5_A1_STARTING_REPOSITORY_D1_IDENTITY, currently 24/16/1)
2. Execute D3.5-A1 implementation and optional approved Mechanism-C governance
3. Establish final approved repository D1 identity (D3_5_A2_FINAL_REPOSITORY_D1_IDENTITY)
4. Freeze final repository D1 identity (D3_5_A2_FINAL_REPOSITORY_D1_IDENTITY_FROZEN = true)
5. Synchronize isolated evaluation target to exactly match final repository D1 identity
6. Freeze isolated materialization identity (D3_5_EVALUATION_D1_MATERIALIZATION_FROZEN = true, isolated_materialization_matches_final_repository_D1 = true)
7. Only then begin D3.5-A2 focused validation

required_change_records: newly frozen final repository D1 identity

d1_identity_freeze_contract.post_freeze_immutability: Once D3_5_A2_FINAL_REPOSITORY_D1_IDENTITY_FROZEN is true, no further objects, relations, provenance, workflows, or materialization writes from another state are permitted. If a defect is discovered later, the pre-exposure freeze must be formally invalidated, execution stopped, and a separately authorized repair performed. Silent mutations are strictly prohibited.

a2_manifest_identity_contract.format_constraints: Bounded metadata records and stable identifier lists only; no ad hoc SHA256 file inventory.
